tools.description:
Call time_now only when the flow is in node SC__SC_TIME.
Argument: iana_timezone = [user_timezone].
Capture the now field in [now] before moving to the summary.
tools.trigger_message: DEBUG time_now: getting the contact's current time

arguments.name: iana_timezone
arguments.description: IANA continent/city timezone for the current time. Send [user_timezone], the same already resolved for availability. (In babynova this tool uses const America/Bogota; family is multi-zone.)

tools.description:
Call callback only when the flow is in node C__CB_RUN and you have a confirmed number and timezone.
Map contact_name, contact_phone, contact_email, reason, context, iana_timezone, preferred_days, and preferred_time_window from their slots.
Capture errors before continuing.
tools.trigger_message: DEBUG callback: escalating to a human callback

arguments.name: contact_name
arguments.description: Contact full name. Injected from {{contact.name}}.

arguments.name: contact_phone
arguments.description: Phone in international format. Send at least one of contact_phone and contact_email.

arguments.name: contact_email
arguments.description: Contact email. Send at least one of contact_phone and contact_email.

arguments.name: reason
arguments.description: Callback reason, mapped to the closest value.

arguments.name: context
arguments.description: Short summary of what happened in the conversation.

arguments.name: preferred_days
arguments.description: Preferred day(s) for the call. Only if a preference was expressed.

arguments.name: preferred_time_window
arguments.description: Preferred time window. Only if a preference was expressed.

arguments.name: iana_timezone
arguments.description: Contact IANA timezone — the same already used for availability. Do not ask again.

tools.description:
Call contact_attempt only when the flow is in node CALL_NO_ANSWER_LOG.
Argument: contact_phone = {{contact.phone}}.
Capture attempt_registered before closing the session.
tools.trigger_message: DEBUG contact_attempt: logging a failed contact attempt

arguments.name: contact_phone
arguments.description: Lead phone that was attempted. Injected from the contact variable {{contact.phone}}.

tools.description: Authorized availability tool for Family Aims commercial appointments (IVF or Surrogacy). Its output is the only authorized source of days and times. MANDATORY EXECUTION TRIGGER: on entering node SC__SC_AV_I (use calendar_type: 'IVF') or SC__SC_AV_S (use calendar_type: 'SUR'), call get_available_slots as the first action of the turn ? imperative, no exception.

arguments.name: iana_timezone
arguments.description: Contact's IANA timezone.

arguments.name: calendar_type
arguments.description: Literal 'IVF' or 'SUR'.

tools.description: Authorized booking tool for Family Aims commercial appointments (IVF or Surrogacy). Creates the appointment from a valid get_available_slots slot. MANDATORY EXECUTION TRIGGER: on entering node SC__SC_BOOK_I (use calendar_type: 'IVF') or SC__SC_BOOK_S (use calendar_type: 'SUR'), call book_appointment as the first action of the turn ? imperative, no exception.

arguments.name: calendar_type
arguments.description: Literal 'IVF' or 'SUR'.

arguments.name: start_date
arguments.description: Start date (start_co) in ISO 8601.

tools.description: Authorized tool to search for existing appointments of a contact by their name in Family Aims calendars.

arguments.name: contact_name
arguments.description: Contact's full name to perform the search.

arguments.name: calendar_type
arguments.description: Calendar filter: 'IVF', 'SUR', or 'BOTH' (default) to search in both.

arguments.name: iana_timezone
arguments.description: IANA timezone to display the found appointments' times. Default: America/Bogota.

arguments.name: language
arguments.description: Language to format results. Default: EN.

tools.description: Authorized tool to cancel/delete an existing appointment in Family Aims calendars.

arguments.name: event_id
arguments.description: Unique identifier of the Google Calendar event to cancel, exactly as returned by the API.

arguments.name: calendar_type
arguments.description: Type of calendar where the appointment resides: 'IVF' or 'SUR'.

arguments.name: iana_timezone
arguments.description: Contact's IANA timezone.
